entries.title: A long card revised while you read it scrolls to its choices on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: When a crewmate revised a long card into folded sections while you were reading near its end, a swipe on your iPhone or iPad could slide the words up inside the card and leave blank space, and its choices stayed out of reach. A swipe now always moves the whole card, so you can reach every part of it and press its choices.
entries.noPicture: The card looks as it did; this fix changes only where a swipe on a revised card takes you.
